---
title: "hsc_bulk"
author: "Koray Dogan Kaya"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
params:
  xlsx_file: "data/patient_bulk/share_maria_bulk_HSC_XY_homologues_Figure2a_20260827.xlsx"
  xy_helper: "xy_dosage_cpm.R"
  output_prefix: "results/hsc/xypair_dosage_HSC_weighted_CPM"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r run-xy-dosage-from-xlsx, fig.width=14, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE}
# Input/output paths are configured in the YAML header.
xlsx_file <- params$xlsx_file
source(params$xy_helper)
dat <- readxl::read_excel(
  xlsx_file,
  sheet = 1,
  .name_repair = "unique"
) |>
  dplyr::select(dplyr::where(\(x) !all(is.na(x))))

names(dat) <- trimws(names(dat))

dat <- dat |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_id = trimws(as.character(sample_id)),
    group = trimws(as.character(group)),
    Sex = trimws(as.character(Sex))
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(sample_id), nzchar(sample_id))

if (anyDuplicated(dat$sample_id))
  stop("sample_id must be unique.")

required_meta <- c("sample_id", "group", "Sex")
if (!all(required_meta %in% names(dat)))
  stop("Required columns: ", paste(required_meta, collapse = ", "))

all_pairs <- c(
  RPS4Y1 = "RPS4X",
  ZFY    = "ZFX",
  USP9Y  = "USP9X",
  DDX3Y  = "DDX3X",
  UTY    = "KDM6A",
  KDM5D  = "KDM5C",
  EIF1AY = "EIF1AX"
)

# Keep only pairs for which both homologues are present.
pairs <- all_pairs[
  names(all_pairs) %in% names(dat) &
    unname(all_pairs) %in% names(dat)
]

if (!length(pairs))
  stop("No complete X/Y pairs were found in the XLSX file.")

genes <- unique(c(names(pairs), unname(pairs)))

dat <- dat |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(genes),
      \(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
    )
  )
datm<-dat |> dplyr::filter(Sex=="Male")
sample_cpm <- datm |>
  dplyr::select(sample_id, dplyr::all_of(genes)) |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("sample_id") |>
  as.matrix()
sample_cpm2<-2^sample_cpm-1
nrow(sample_cpm)

if (any(!is.finite(sample_cpm)) || any(sample_cpm < 0))
  stop("Gene columns must contain finite, non-negative CPM values.")

xy_result <- xy_dosage_cpm(
  cpm = sample_cpm2,
  gender = stats::setNames(datm$Sex, datm$sample_id),
  group = stats::setNames(datm$group, datm$sample_id),
  condition = NULL,
  pairs = pairs,
  reference_group = "CN-Male",
  out_prefix = params$output_prefix,
  group_label_size = 14,
  width = 14,
  height = 4
)

cat(
  "Pairs used:\n",
  paste(names(pairs), unname(pairs), sep = "/", collapse = "\n"),
  "\n\nPairs omitted:\n",
  paste(
    setdiff(
      paste(names(all_pairs), unname(all_pairs), sep = "/"),
      paste(names(pairs), unname(pairs), sep = "/")
    ),
    collapse = "\n"
  ),
  "\n"
)

knitr::kable(
  xy_result$metrics,
  digits = 3,
  caption = paste(
    "X/Y homolog expression relative to the",
    "CN-Male X-plus-Y total for each pair."
  )
)

```

```{r export-software-versions, include=FALSE}
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()),
           file.path(dirname(params$output_prefix), "sessionInfo.txt"))
```
